title: .NET Aspire Local Development Orchestration
description: Master .NET Aspire for local development: service discovery, containers, health checks, configuration, and OpenTelemetry in a unified AppHost.

data.text: .NET Aspire is a .NET-based application stack with tooling that streamlines the development, testing, and production deployment of distributed, containerizable services. The Aspire AppHost acts as a local orchestrator — provisioning dependencies (databases, caches, message brokers) as containers, injecting connection strings, configuring health checks, and wiring up distributed tracing — all with a single project reference.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: .NET Aspire orchestrates local dependencies (databases, caches, brokers) as containers from a single AppHost
Service discovery is automatic — referenced services expose typed connection strings
Health checks and OpenTelemetry are built-in with a real-time dashboard
Aspire bridges the gap between local development and production container deployments
data.takeaway: .NET Aspire transforms local development from manual service provisioning to declarative infrastructure-as-code, ensuring consistency from laptop to production.
